triples(n: int) -> Pipe[(int, int, int)] =>

        (a::n) |> flat_map(b =>

fullSource:
use default

triples(n: int) -> Pipe[(int, int, int)] =>
    (1::n) |> flat_map(a =>
        (a::n) |> flat_map(b =>
            (b::n)
                |> filter(c => a * a + b * b == c * c)
                |> map(c => (a, b, c))))

write_line(triples(20) |> join(", "))
